messages:
devon-sre: Heads up — multiple EU customers reporting increased latency and intermittent 5xxs. Initial pattern looks like requests are being routed to us-west instead of eu-west. Starting triage in this thread.

incident-bot: ALERT: routing-map change deployed 2026-03-17T09:03:00Z (commit sha: a1b2c3) — adjusted region weightings for 'eu' pool.

jordan-cs: ACME reported big latency regression (200-600ms -> 800ms-2s) + sporadic 502s. Repro from their side:
```
curl -i https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXXXX' \\n  -H 'X-Region: eu-west-1' \\n  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
Their traceroute resolves to a us-west IP and the response headers show `X-Routing-Trace: pool=us-west-2`.

ingrid: I can confirm routing-service TTL change landed in the same deploy (60s -> 0s). That forced immediate rebalance and cleared sticky session keys. When affinity dropped router picked weights that favour us pool.

uma_engineer: Also seeing fallback behavior that contributed: fallback_policy=nearest_available but pool labels didn't match model-variants between eu and us pools. When eu pool had transient model-load errors, the router fell back to us pool which doesn't have the same tenant routing header mapping — produced 403 (auth validation mismatch) for some requests and 502 for model load mismatch for others. Logs attached:
```
[router] decision: route->us-west-2 reason=weight_rebalance fallback=nearest_available pool_unhealthy=true
[auth] token-map-mismatch tenant=acme result=403
[backend] model-load-fail model=redwood-13b-sharded err=missing-variant -> 502
```

devon-sre: Actions taken: 1) rolled back routing-map to previous commit (revert applied at 1967002560), 2) purged region-affinity cache across edge routers, 3) reintroduced sticky TTL to 60s temporarily. Notifying CS and paging owners.

natalie_support: Confirmed — told ACME we rolled back and offered proactive credits. They asked for impacted window and root cause. Can we quantify affected customers and exact time range?

alexm: From router metrics: ~12k cross-region proxied requests in 37m window starting at 2026-03-17T09:03. Error breakdown: 78% latency increase, 11% 502, 6% 403, rest timeouts.

uma_engineer: Internal repro steps for validation:
```
# simulate EU request that gets misrouted
curl -v https://api.redwood.com/v1/healthcheck \\n  -H 'X-Client-Region: eu-west-1' \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-test'
# inspect router trace headers for pool selection
# expect: X-Routing-Trace: pool=us-west-2 fallback=nearest_available reason=pool_unhealthy
```

devon-sre: Proposed post-incident tasks (owners assigned inline):
- Audit routing config PRs and add strict label validation (ingrid)
- Add integration tests to ensure fallback pool label compatibility (uma_engineer)
- Alert: high cross-region routing >1% sustained for 5m (devon-sre)
- CS customer communication template + compensation calc (natalie_support)
- Add regression test in canary for affinity TTL changes (eng-ci)

ingrid: Root cause hypothesis: the weight-rebalance PR used a shorthand label `eu` instead of canonical `eu-west-1` in the routing-map. That caused affinity keys to be dropped and the router to evaluate default weights which leaned to US. PR#4217 introduced the change.

jordan-cs: ACME accepted the credit offer. They want a concise summary for their legal team — impacted window 09:03:00Z -> 09:40:30Z (rollback + stabilization). Please confirm exact timestamps for the postmortem.

ops-bot: deploy revert completed at 1967002560 by devon-sre — no errors reported.

natalie_support: I'll draft the external comms now. Suggested text: "We experienced cross-region routing that caused higher latency and inconsistent auth responses for EU customers between 09:03-09:40 UTC. We reverted the routing change, purged sticky caches, and are issuing credits. Full postmortem to follow." Thoughts? :thumbsup:

devon-sre: Looks good. Owners: uma_engineer -> fix & tests, ingrid -> config audit + correct PR labels, natalie_support -> customer comms, devon-sre -> alerting & rollout guard. Postmortem doc targeted EOD.

uma_engineer: Opened internal bug ISSUE-2938 with repro, logs, and unit test plan. Will follow up with PR to validation library.

end of thread.
